# AI Resume Builder — Resume Constructor

> Open-source AI resume builder. Deterministic ATS scoring for 36 job roles and any job description, AI rewrites that never invent facts, and ATS-readable PDF, Word and plain-text exports plus 10 designed templates.

Site: https://resume-constructor-gev44.vercel.app
Source: https://github.com/GEV44/resume-constructor

## Pages

- [Home](https://resume-constructor-gev44.vercel.app/): Product overview and features.
- [Free ATS Checker](https://resume-constructor-gev44.vercel.app/ats-checker): Paste a resume and optional job description for an instant score, missing keywords and fixes. Runs in the browser; nothing is uploaded.
- [Sign Up](https://resume-constructor-gev44.vercel.app/signup): Create a free account for AI review, rewrites and exports.
- [Log In](https://resume-constructor-gev44.vercel.app/login): Sign in.

## How scoring works

Five weighted components (skills, experience, projects, education, quantified impact), with weights set per role category. When a job description is supplied, its keyword coverage is 30% of the overall score. The same input always produces the same score.
